question: What outcome is said to follow from abstaining from food by day?
premises: Abstention from eating occurs by day
Age and death are linked in the result
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go to the death of age.
uncertainties: The phrase vayo-mṛtyuṃ is ambiguous and may mean death from old age or transcendence of age-death
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will go to the death of old age.
